label: finite JSON number, never string; scalar target
prompt: English task-specific context + input JSON; excludes labels and provenance
input: original-scale typed feature object; null allowed; no statistical imputation
source_refs: one or more original file/1-based data row references; excludes header row
duplicate_count: number of identical task/input/label source occurrences collapsed
group_id: known-dependence grouping key, dataset-scoped; does not replace chronological splitting
split: Published partitions retained for CompLex, ASAP2, C-MAPSS and UJIIndoorLoc. Other sources use unassigned. Consult per-source metadata for dependencies and split guidance.
quality_flags: review flags for preserved source anomalies or explicitly replaced measurements; no flag is not a guarantee of clean data
target_transform: Per-source declared transformation; no new statistical scaling. Source means/relative fitness are identified in metadata.
entity_id: optional known subject/station ID for grouping; never included in prompt unless explicitly a domain feature
target_observations: optional SGEMM four original runtime measurements; outcomes only, never input

numeric_precision.rule: Non-integral finite floats rounded to at most 12 significant decimal digits; integers, null and strings unchanged; no fixed decimal-place rounding or clipping.

type: continuous for measured/derived scalar targets; ordinal for ordered discrete scores such as ASAP2 1–6
sample_id: For batches 3 and 4 sha256([task_id,input_hash,label,official_split]) first 24 hex; earlier release IDs unchanged.
